dressCode: An elegant outfit is required: no shorts or sportswear, and men must wear a suit jacket. Guests who don't follow the dress code can be refused entry.
children: There are no high chairs and no children's menu.
bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's website, or by email. Arrive at Entrance 1 of the Eiffel Tower (Allée des Refuzniks), where a priority line leads to the restaurant's private lift. Your booking doesn't include the top of the tower; buy those tickets separately.
cancellation: The whole table orders the same set menu, and the final number of guests must be confirmed at least 3 working days before.
